BEFORE YOU ORDER

Order & delivery information.

Please read these details before placing an order. Customised products are made according to the information you provide.

Payment & confirmation

100% advance payment is required. An order is confirmed only after payment has been received and verified by Ritika. A WhatsApp order message alone is not an order confirmation.

Preparation & delivery

Standard preparation time is usually 6–7 days. Orders are shipped through DTDC. Delivery generally takes 3–4 days after dispatch, depending on the destination and courier service.

Shipping & pickup

Shipping charges depend on the delivery area and parcel size. There is no free-shipping offer. Local pickup is available in Shamli, by arrangement.

Customisation & bulk orders

Colour, names, initials and messages can be customised where applicable. Different designs, sizes or special requirements must be discussed on WhatsApp. Bulk order minimum quantity is 15 pieces. Gift packaging is available for bulk orders on request at an additional charge.

Urgent orders

Urgent orders are generally not accepted. Requests from Shamli may be discussed only if availability permits; please check on WhatsApp before placing a request.

Cancellation, returns & replacement

As products are customised, cancellations, returns and refunds are not accepted under the stated store policy. Replacement requests are considered only with a proper, continuous unboxing video as proof. Contact Ritika promptly if an item arrives damaged or incorrect. This policy is subject to applicable consumer protection law.

QUICK ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions.

Useful information before you place an order.

How do I place an order?

Select a product, fill in the order form and submit it. WhatsApp will open with your order details. Send the message to Ritika to continue.

When is my order confirmed?

Only after 100% advance payment has been received and verified by Ritika. Sending an enquiry on WhatsApp does not confirm an order.

How long does an order take?

Preparation usually takes 6–7 days. Delivery generally takes another 3–4 days after dispatch, depending on your location and courier service.

Do you deliver across India?

Yes. Orders are shipped across India through DTDC. Shipping charges depend on the destination and parcel size.

Can I customise a product?

Colour, names, initials and messages can be customised where applicable. For a different design, size or special requirement, contact Ritika on WhatsApp for discussion and a quote.

Do you accept bulk orders?

Yes. The minimum order quantity for bulk orders is 15 pieces. Gift packaging can be requested for bulk orders at an additional charge.

Can I request an urgent order?

Urgent orders are generally not accepted. Shamli local requests may be considered only subject to availability. Confirm on WhatsApp before ordering.

Can I cancel, return or get a refund?

The store's stated policy does not accept cancellations, returns or refunds for customised products. This is subject to applicable consumer protection law. Contact Ritika if there is a problem with your order.

How do I get my tracking details?

Ritika will share the DTDC tracking number after dispatch. You can contact her on WhatsApp for order updates.

Is local pickup available?

Yes. Local pickup can be arranged in Shamli. Select local pickup in the order form and confirm the arrangement on WhatsApp.
